_about: Invented parent training intakes in the shape of one production parent note that came out wrong (2026-10-03). No client data: every goal, count and event here is made up. Each case lists what a right draft must show; scripts/lib/parent-shape-checks.mjs reads these. Variations change the goals, the counts and which rule is under test, so a fix cannot pass by matching one note.

cases.intake:
Goals assessed in parent training session included parent goals, client skill goals, and client behavior goals.
Client Goals:
Complete Functional One-Step Instructions (Listener Resp.)|"Stand up" + raise hands|0/3|%O

Parent Goals:

2. Parent Goal: Implement Toilet Training Plan|Prompt to Go to Bathroom|2/0|100%|+,+
3. Parent Goal: Implement Toilet Training Plan|Use Timer|2/0|100%|+,+
BCBA met with caregivers and reviewed an upcoming staff transition the parents requested. Onboarding of a new technician begins in the next 2 weeks.

answers.question: You wrote 0/3 on the one-step instruction. What happened on those trials?
answers.answer: Tantrum behavior occurred on 1 trial, and the other 2 were completed with a physical prompt. The program is to complete them with a gesture prompt.

answers.question: Climbing: how did caregivers respond?
answers.answer: Add Parent Goal: Implement BIP Climbing: Prompt FCR (Antecedent) 6/1 85%. Parents prompted FCR 5 times when precursors were observed, and climbing happened in 1 of those 5. The BT was running the session earlier while BCBA revised a protocol.

forbidPhrases: physical prompt was required on the other.
expect.caregiverResponse: Parent/Family is trying to learn new strategies, but there are some small barriers to generalization.
